name: Vegetable Ghassi
steps: Dry-roast chilies, coriander and cumin for 3 minutes until fragrant. Add half the coconut for the last minute; cool and grind with tamarind and 150 ml measured water to a smooth red paste.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pot. Crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves for 30 seconds. Add potatoes and carrots and toss for 2 minutes.
Add 250 ml remaining water and salt, cover and cook 7 minutes. Add beans and cauliflower; cook 5 minutes until all vegetables are almost tender.
Stir in red coconut-spice paste and jaggery. Simmer uncovered 7–8 minutes until gravy thickens and coats the vegetables; add the remaining fresh coconut.
Taste for sweet-sour-spicy balance and salt. Serve hot with neer dosa or rice.
tips: Roasted chilies, coconut and tamarind give ghassi its signature deep red coastal gravy.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
